records.jp: だいぶ育ちましたね。<CR>無事に収穫できそうでよかったです
records.en_original: It's really grown, hasn't it? I'm glad we'll have a good harvest.
records.en: It's really grown, hasn't it? I'm glad we'll have a good harvest.

records.jp: どうしました？
records.en_original: What is it?
records.en: What is it?

records.jp: こんな風に生えてるんだと思って
records.en_original: So this is how it grows.
records.en: So this is how it grows.

records.jp: ここにたんぼ作るまで、ちゃんと見たことなかったから
records.en_original: I've never seen a rice field up close before.
records.en: I've never seen a rice field up close before.

records.jp: え、本当ですか
records.en_original: Huh? Really?
records.en: Huh? Really?

records.jp: いや、旅先で移動中とかテレビでは見たことあるよ！<CR>ただ近くでまじまじと見る機会がなかっただけで
records.en_original: I mean, I've seen them while traveling and on TV! But I've never had the chance to really look at them like this.
records.en: I mean, I've seen them while traveling and on TV! But I've never had the chance to really look at them like this.

records.jp: そんな人もいるんですね。<CR>カルチャーショックです……
records.en_original: I never knew people like that existed. Talk about culture shock...
records.en: I never knew people like that existed. Talk about culture shock...

records.jp: 寒いところじゃなくても育つんだなって
records.en_original: It can even grow in warm places, huh?
records.en: It can even grow in warm places, huh?

records.jp: お米は本来、暖かい地域の植物だったんですよ
records.en_original: The rice plant originally came from a warm climate.
records.en: The rice plant originally came from a warm climate.

records.jp: そうなの？
records.en_original: Oh, really?
records.en: Oh, really?

records.jp: ただ、水もいっぱい必要なんです
records.en_original: But it needs a lot of water.
records.en: But it needs a lot of water.

records.jp: なので、冬に沢山雪が降って、夏も水が豊富な地域で<CR>育てるようになったんです
records.en_original: That's why we started to grow it in areas with a lot of snowfall in the winter, as they have plenty of water during the summer months.
records.en: That's why we started to grow it in areas with a lot of snowfall in the winter, as they have plenty of water during the summer months.

records.jp: 他にも昼と夜の気温の差が大きい方がいいとか、<CR>お米を育てるのに向いている条件は色々ありますけど
records.en_original: It also needs a place where the temperature rises during the day and falls at night. There are a lot of conditions to consider.
records.en: It also needs a place where the temperature rises during the day and falls at night. There are a lot of conditions to consider.

records.jp: え、もしかして、お米育てたことある？
records.en_original: Huh... Have you ever grown rice before?
records.en: Huh... Have you ever grown rice before?

records.jp: いえ。でも、興味があって調べたことがあったので
records.en_original: No, but I've read up on it out of curiosity.
records.en: No, but I've read up on it out of curiosity.

records.jp: （さすが詩帆さん、勉強熱心だなぁ）
records.en_original: (That's Shiho all right, studious as always.)
records.en: (That's Shiho all right, studious as always.)

records.jp: でもさ、ここまで育てるの大変だったんじゃない？<CR>実質ほどんど詩帆さんとこころで育ててたじゃん
records.en_original: But wasn't it hard to grow? You and Kokoro practically did it all yourselves.
records.en: But wasn't it hard to grow? You and Kokoro practically did it all yourselves.

records.jp: いえいえ、そんなことなかったですよ
records.en_original: No, no, not at all.
records.en: No, no, not at all.

records.jp: 任せっぱなしでごめんね
records.en_original: Sorry for making you do all the work.
records.en: Sorry for making you do all the work.

records.jp: 本当に全然大丈夫でしたから。<CR>むしろ、夢が叶って嬉しかったです
records.en_original: It was nothing, really. If anything, I was happy one of my dreams came true.
records.en: It was nothing, really. If anything, I was happy one of my dreams came true.

records.jp: 夢？
records.en_original: What dream?
records.en: What dream?

records.jp: 「料理を素材から作る」という夢が叶いました。<CR>水や育て方もこだわることができましたし
records.en_original: I'd always wanted to make food with ingredients that I grew. I enjoyed watering them and taking care of them as they grew.
records.en: I'd always wanted to make food with ingredients that I grew. I enjoyed watering them and taking care of them as they grew.

records.jp: それはもうプロの領域では？
records.en_original: You're basically a professional at this point.
records.en: You're basically a professional at this point.

records.jp: 愛着湧いちゃって食べづらくなってたりする？
records.en_original: Isn't it hard to eat something you've grown so fond of?
records.en: Isn't it hard to eat something you've grown so fond of?

records.jp: うーん、かわいいとは思いますけど<CR>あくまで食べるために育ててますからね
records.en_original: Hmm, I do think the plants are cute, but at the end of the day, it's still just food.
records.en: Hmm, I do think the plants are cute, but at the end of the day, it's still just food.

records.jp: それはそれ、これはこれって感じです
records.en_original: It's easy for me to keep things like that separate in my mind.
records.en: It's easy for me to keep things like that separate in my mind.

records.jp: 詩帆さんのそういうところ、私好きだよ
records.en_original: I like that about you, Shiho.
records.en: I like that about you, Shiho.

records.jp: お米が採れたら何作ろうかなぁ。<CR>星崎さん、食べたいものありますか？
records.en_original: What should I cook after we harvest the rice? Is there anything you want to eat, Ao?
records.en: What should I cook after we harvest the rice? Is there anything you want to eat, Ao?

records.jp: 炊き込みご飯食べたい
records.en_original: I want to eat mixed rice.
records.en: I want to eat mixed rice.

records.jp: いいですね！　具は何にしましょうか
records.en_original: That's a great idea! What should we put in it?
records.en: That's a great idea! What should we put in it?

records.jp: あー、でもあれはないし、あれもないし……
records.en_original: Oh... We're missing some of the ingredients, though...
records.en: Oh... We're missing some of the ingredients, though...

records.jp: 限られた材料で美味しく作るのが、<CR>腕の見せどころなんじゃないの
records.en_original: You can show off your skills by cooking up something good with what we have!
records.en: You can show off your skills by cooking up something good with what we have!

records.jp: 言いましたね？<CR>お腹を空かせて待っていてください！
records.en_original: Is that a challenge? I hope you're hungry!
records.en: Is that a challenge? I hope you're hungry!

records.jp: やった～。楽しみにしてる
records.en_original: Yay! I can't wait!
records.en: Yay! I can't wait!

records.jp: フォー食べたい
records.en_original: I want to eat pho.
records.en: I want to eat pho.

records.jp: えっ、フォーですか？
records.en_original: Huh? Pho?
records.en: Huh? Pho?

records.jp: うん。難しそう？
records.en_original: Yeah. Is it hard to make?
records.en: Yeah. Is it hard to make?

records.jp: いえ、作れなくはないと思いますけど<CR>意外だったので
records.en_original: No, it shouldn't be too difficult. I just didn't expect that.
records.en: No, it shouldn't be too difficult. I just didn't expect that.

records.jp: そのまま炊いて食べるのも美味しいかもしれないけど<CR>あえて麺にするという贅沢もありかなって
records.en_original: White rice is always good plain, but wouldn't making it into noodles be even better?
records.en: White rice is always good plain, but wouldn't making it into noodles be even better?

records.jp: ……一理ありますね
records.en_original: That's a good point.
records.en: That's a good point.

records.jp: それに、うどんとか小麦の麺は手打ちしたこと<CR>ありますが、米粉の麺はないですし……
records.en_original: I've made wheat noodles like udon by hand before, but I've never made rice noodles...
records.en: I've made wheat noodles like udon by hand before, but I've never made rice noodles...

records.jp: これは挑戦しがいがありそうです！
records.en_original: This ought to be a good challenge!
records.en: This ought to be a good challenge!

records.jp: よかった。試食なら任せてね
records.en_original: Great! Let me know if you need a taste tester.
records.en: Great! Let me know if you need a taste tester.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
